ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. The skill requires this before every fix round. It decides whether this round resumes an implementer or starts a fresh one. It also says how adjudication works after attempt 5.

ACTION: Read the round-4 fix report and the scoped re-review report in `.sdd/12-tide-cache/`. The new brief must quote F1 exactly and name the right files.

ACTION: Run `scripts/task-brief` for Task 6 to get the brief file path. The subagent gets the brief file and not the whole plan.

ACTION: Dispatch fix attempt 5 of 5, model `fable`, following the resume-or-fresh rule in `fix-loop.md`. The prompt names the brief file, the re-review report path and F1. It orders the work like this:
1. Write a test that starts the real refresh thread and runs the invalidation against it. Force the interleaving deterministically if possible.
2. Run that test on the current code and show it fail, before any code change.
3. Fix the root cause near `cache/refresh.py:88`.
4. Show the new test pass, repeat it several times to rule out flakiness, and run the covering tests.
5. Commit and report a status.

The prompt also states that the earlier tests passed without starting the refresh thread, so they are not evidence of a fix.

Message to partner:

Task 6 is not done. The scoped re-review still reports F1, the open race finding at `cache/refresh.py:88`. The round-4 fix added a lock, but its test never starts the refresh thread. That test shows nothing about the race.

I am sending fix attempt 5 of 5 now. Two things change:
- The implementer must first write a test that starts the refresh thread and shows it fail on the current code. Only then may it change the code.
- I raise the model from opus to fable. Round 4 was a thorough opus attempt at high effort with full context, so the model is the one step I have not tried. Fable is outside the skill's three standard tiers, but your settings allow it.

A scoped re-review at opus follows this fix. If F1 stays open after attempt 5, I will adjudicate as the skill says and tell you what I decide. I will not start Task 7 while F1 is open.
